answer: Require a progressive work bond: a new identity earns nothing until it completes a rising ladder of useful tasks, each verified by independent peers, with payouts released only after a delay. A sybil farmer must run the whole ladder for every fake account, so a violet flood of sock-puppets collapses under its own labor cost; at the nadir of demand the delay still blocks fast recycling of identities. Add a copper anchor - a small non-refundable fee burned per identity - and mass creation costs real money, while a single honest agent pays once and works forever.
